artifact: Q-VLA Forge Sprint 7.13 Phase 1 vs Phase 2 Separation

rows.phase1_executed: Shared lightweight VLA-style framework evaluated across autonomous-driving and robotics proxy domains.
rows.phase1_evidence: Framework, interface, evaluation, robustness-harness, metric-schema, and protocol reuse.
rows.phase1_boundary: No universal trained policy, shared trained policy weights, zero-shot transfer, or universal safety controller was demonstrated.
rows.phase2_objective: Evaluate stronger shared representations, explicit weight-sharing controls, and matched cross-domain transfer experiments.

rows.phase1_executed: FP32, INT8, SVD, and TT/MPS compression were evaluated under the frozen criterion.
rows.phase1_evidence: INT8 passed the joint compression-quality criterion in both proxy domains at approximately 3.85x effective storage compression.
rows.phase1_boundary: Evaluated SVD and TT/MPS configurations did not satisfy the same joint criterion. No TT/MPS superiority claim is supported.
rows.phase2_objective: Evaluate stronger low-rank and tensor-network configurations on larger VLA components.

rows.phase1_executed: Training-efficiency experiments were evaluated under the locked three-seed target-reaching protocol.
rows.phase1_evidence: The evaluated methods produced measurable target-reaching and validation statistics.
rows.phase1_boundary: Phase 1 did not demonstrate a robust 10% or greater optimizer-step efficiency improvement across all three locked seeds.
rows.phase2_objective: Evaluate stronger optimization and representation strategies under matched target-reaching protocols.

rows.phase1_executed: Classical PPO was evaluated across both domains and all three principal seeds.
rows.phase1_evidence: Classical PPO reached all 6 of 6 frozen domain-seed targets.
rows.phase1_boundary: This result is limited to the frozen pilot-scale proxy environments and does not establish production policy performance.
rows.phase2_objective: Scale policy evaluation to stronger environments and more realistic VLA policy workloads.

rows.phase1_executed: A compact 4-qubit PQC/QML actor and matched classical control were evaluated under the frozen RL protocol.
rows.phase1_evidence: The QML actor was substantially more parameter-compact than the full PPO actor.
rows.phase1_boundary: QML reached 0 of 6 frozen targets. No QML sample-efficiency, computational, quantum-speedup, or quantum-hardware advantage was demonstrated.
rows.phase2_objective: Screen alternative encodings, circuit structures, matched compact classical controls, and optional QPU execution only where scientifically justified.

rows.phase1_executed: No-filter, clipping, and classical Lyapunov-guided filtering were evaluated under the frozen proxy safety contracts.
rows.phase1_evidence: Clipping and Lyapunov filtering produced zero observed clean violation-step rate in both proxy domains.
rows.phase1_boundary: This is empirical pilot evidence only. It does not establish formal safety, Lyapunov stability, invariance, certification, production readiness, or real-world vehicle or robot safety.
rows.phase2_objective: Evaluate stronger formal constraints, intervention latency, realistic failure modes, and closed-loop safety validation.

rows.phase1_executed: Gaussian observation noise, structured-state perturbation, and direct action perturbation were evaluated.
rows.phase1_evidence: Robustness behavior and direct-action recovery were quantified under the frozen synthetic perturbation protocol.
rows.phase1_boundary: Synthetic perturbation results do not establish real-world robustness or production fault coverage.
rows.phase2_objective: Expand to realistic sensor, actuator, environment, and distribution-shift failure models.

rows.phase1_executed: Compression, QML policy, and safety-filter components were independently evaluated across both proxy domains.
rows.phase1_evidence: The intended factorial contains 16 domain/configuration cells classified as component-only evidence.
rows.phase1_boundary: DIRECT = 0 and COMPONENT_ONLY = 16. No matched end-to-end Compression x QML x Safety factorial configuration was directly executed. No synthetic full-system metric, interaction effect, or full-system superiority claim is supported.
rows.phase2_objective: Execute all 16 matched Compression x QML x Safety domain/configuration cells and estimate main and interaction effects from direct integrated evidence.
